findings.description: The policy grants ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on Resource "*", giving this user full administrative control over compute, storage, and serverless services with no resource or action scoping. A compromised access key allows unrestricted data exfiltration, resource destruction, and privilege escalation (e.g. via lambda:CreateFunction or iam-passed roles).

A static IAM access key is created for the svc_deploy user and never rotated; combined with the unrestricted policy above, any exposure of this key grants full account-wide access to ec2, s3, lambda, and cloudwatch.

svc_deploy_key_material outputs the access key's encrypted_secret, which writes the secret material into Terraform state and any remote state backend as well as console/CI output. Anyone with read access to state obtains the credential for an admin-equivalent user.
